headline: Mitsubishi Mexico Prepares Strategy Ahead of Arrival of Chinese Brands; Acknowledges Tax-Related Challenges
summary: Mitsubishi Mexico president Ah-Kin Vázquez said the company's strategy is to make consumers aware they are buying a quality vehicle with a warranty, and acknowledged fiscal challenges.
why: Mitsubishi Motors is a Japanese automaker, and rising competition from Chinese brands in Mexico affects its market share and pricing.
original_headline: Mitsubishi México alista estrategia ante llegada de marcas chinas; reconoce retos en materia fiscal
